descriptionPlain:
At PointClickCare our mission is simple: to help providers deliver exceptional care. And that starts with our people. As a leading health tech company that’s founder-led and privately held, we empower our employees to push boundaries, innovate, and shape the future of healthcare.
 
With the largest long-term and post-acute care dataset and a Marketplace of 400+ integrated partners, our platform serves over 30,000 provider organizations, making a real difference in millions of lives. We also reinvest a significant percentage of our revenue back into research and development, ensuring our employees have the resources to innovate and make a lasting impact. Recognized by Forbes as a top private cloud company and honored as one of Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, we offer flexibility, growth opportunities, and meaningful work. 
 
At PointClickCare, we empower our people to be the architects of a smarter healthcare future; one that is human-first and accelerated by AI to create meaningful and lasting change. Employees harness AI as a catalyst for creativity, productivity, and thoughtful decision-making. By integrating AI tools into our daily workflows, collaboration is enhanced, outcomes are improved, and every team member has the proficiency to maximize their impact. It all starts with our hiring practices where we uncover AI expertise that complements our mission, and we continue to invest in training and development to nurture innovation throughout the employee journey.
 
Join us in redefining healthcare — so it doesn’t just survive, it thrives. To learn more about PointClickCare, check out Life at PointClickCare and connect with us on Glassdoor and LinkedIn.
 
 
**Travel to Office expectations**
For Remote Roles: If this role is remote, there will be in-office events that will require travel to and from the Mississauga and/or Salt Lake City office. These will include, but not limited to, onboarding, team events, semi-annual and annual team meetings.
 
For Hybrid Roles: If this role is Hybrid, there will be an expectation to reside within commutable distance to the office/location specified in the job listing. This will include, but not limited to, weekly/bi-weekly/monthly events in the office with your specific team. This is a requirement for this role.


Team Summary:
The Enablement team is a focused group of generalist SRE engineers who act as internal SRE consultants to PointClickCare's development teams — helping them get their products into production reliably, securely, and quickly. We don't own services or platforms; we make the teams who do more autonomous — building alongside them, then leaving behind the patterns, automation, and knowledge they need to run what they ship. You will spend a significant portion of your time hands-on — designing infrastructure, building pipelines and automation, hardening services for production, and contributing self-service capabilities to our Operations platforms across cloud environments like Azure. The team collaborates closely with product engineering, platform, SRE, and security teams across the technology organization.
 
Job Summary:
Enablement exists to make PointClickCare's development teams autonomous in production — so that shipping a new service doesn't depend on a queue of operational requests. We solve the complex, cross-cutting infrastructure problems that don't yet fit an existing pattern or self-service platform — the 20% that standard paths can't handle — through sound SRE practices, well-designed automation, and a security-first mindset. Then we turn those solutions into reusable patterns and platform capabilities, so the next team can serve itself. Success is measured not by what we own, but by how many teams can deliver and operate confidently without us.
 
Key responsibilities:
Partner with development teams to take new and changing services into production — designing the infrastructure, CI/CD, observability, and security controls each service needs, and building alongside the team so they own the result
Identify recurring developer requests and operational toil and eliminate them at the source — contributing self-service capabilities, reusable infrastructure-as-code modules, and automation to our Operations platforms
Turn one-off solutions into documented, repeatable patterns; lead production readiness reviews covering SLOs, alerting, security, and recoverability — pushing back with evidence when designs introduce operational risk
Transfer ownership cleanly — leaving every engagement with runbooks, documentation, and hands-on knowledge so development teams can operate, troubleshoot, and evolve what was built without depending on Enablement
Mentor engineers, influence design reviews, and champion SRE practices — SLOs, blameless postmortems, infrastructure as code, and secure-by-default design — across engineering teams through influence rather than authority
Qualification and Skills:
Minimum:
5+ years in SRE, platform engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure roles supporting production cloud environments and mission-critical applications across multiple teams or services
Strong proficiency with observability — metrics, logging, distributed tracing, SLI/SLO frameworks — and production operations including incident response and blameless postmortems
Strong proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), GitOps practices, and CI/CD for both application and infrastructure delivery
Strong proficiency with cloud platform administration — compute, networking, storage, and identity — with deep, hands-on production experience in Azure or AWS, including containerized workloads (e.g., Kubernetes)
Working proficiency with platform security — network segmentation, secrets management, encryption at rest and in transit, and least-privilege access
Strong programming skills for automation, self-service tooling, and infrastructure management, with a proven track record of measurably reducing operational toil (e.g., ticket volume, manual requests, hours reclaimed)
Strong communication and documentation skills — able to write runbooks, teach and pair with engineers, influence teams you don't manage, and translate technical complexity for diverse audiences
Preferred:
Experience building or contributing to internal developer platforms, self-service tooling, or golden-path templates
Consulting, professional services, or embedded-SRE experience — internal or external — partnering with teams to deliver outcomes they will own
Experience with disaster recovery planning, progressive delivery patterns (blue/green, canary), and capacity or cost optimization (FinOps)
Experience in healthcare, life sciences, or other highly regulated industries with data privacy requirements
